verdict.oneLineSummary: Fast dev mode, but public launch is capped at 25 users until Spotify approves a Quota Extension review.

twoClocks.worksInDev: ~15 min (strictly capped at 25 whitelisted Spotify accounts)

capabilityCheck.question: Can an agent freely stream audio or ingest music metadata for LLM analysis?
capabilityCheck.detail: Playback control and playlist creation work well with active Spotify Premium accounts. However, Spotify's Developer Terms strictly prohibit using API data, lyrics, or listening history for LLM model training. Furthermore, dev mode is hard-capped at 25 whitelisted Spotify accounts until Quota Extension is approved.
capabilityCheck.warningCallout: AI agent builders cannot train models or cache catalog data per Spotify terms; playback requires users to hold active Spotify Premium.

prerequisites: Active Spotify Premium account for testing playback controls

fields.name: Which API/SDKs are you planning to use?

steps.text: Add user emails under User Management.

fields.name: User Management
fields.note: In Development Mode, ONLY users explicitly added here (up to 25) can log in. All other users get 'User not registered in developer dashboard' error.

steps.text: Apply for Quota Extension to enable public distribution.

fields.name: Quota Extension Request
fields.note: Requires video demo showing UI and proof that data is not used for AI model training.

blockers.issue: Development Mode 25-user hard cap: Public users encounter an unexplained authentication error unless manually added by email to the developer dashboard.
blockers.workaround: Submit a Quota Extension form before marketing your integration to external users.

composio.recommendation: Composio provides managed Spotify connections that bypass individual quota management for standard tool execution.

evidence.claim: Spotify enforces a strict 25-user limit in developer mode and requires manual approval via Quota Extension to open access.
evidence.label: SOURCED
